scene.language: This scenario is representing a check in soccer. There's an opponent, a coach, and a teammate. The opponent, naturally, has different distances, comes in dis-- different distances from the coach, you know. Some defenders will play tight defense and be closer to the co- clo- closer to their player or some defenders will be farther away, you know, play more loose defense. So here in this check, the purpose is for, to create space for the teammate. So the coach will move cl-, you know, check at an angle, either to the right or to the left, and ho- lo- hopefully, you know, create space from the opponent and the teammate, and this will either leave the teammate to have space, you know, to dribble forward in another direction or they can pass to the coach if the coach is a good option. (click) [0][1]So here, the coach is checked, and naturally because, you know, the coach gets to, to check, they have an a-- they have a time advantage and it'll take the time for the defender to react and follow the coach. With this space, the teammate looks to pass to the coach. [2][3][4](click) Now notice, the coach and the opponent is still pretty close to the coach so it doesn't make sense for the opponent to dribble forward. In this case, they can pass it back to the teammate. (click)[5][6][7]
